title: The Curse of Monkey Island
shortDescription: The Curse of Monkey Island helps define a PC (Windows) adventure path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Keeps a documented adventure option visible in the PC (Windows) collection.
Keeps the external item link distinct from the deterministic catalog method.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Indexed for the PC (Windows) adventure discovery path using a linked Wikidata platform-and-genre statement; this remains a catalog-method note with no imported numerical signal.
